name: Fukubi Clinic
description: Fukubi Clinic is a clean, accessible block theme tailored for outpatient gastroenterology, digestive health, and medical specialist practices. Built around calm slate tones and precise typography, it features dot-matrix timetable cards, multi-circle hero compositions, and structured symptom indexes. Every layout prioritises patient clarity, transparent fee disclosures, and unhurried clinical storytelling. Figtree for headings, Public Sans for reading. Sample content in English; Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German follow. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; calm, short scroll reveals and one parallax photograph.
